scenarios.title: Create an account
steps: Open the public lobby and choose account access.
Submit a valid gamertag, email, and password.
Confirm the authenticated user bar replaces the sign-in entry point.
Confirm the user can return to the public lobby without losing the session.

expected: registration response is successful
player identity is correlated without email or password in telemetry
auth.register trace and users INSERT are observable locally
unknown_until_run: exact database CRUD rollup for the local run

scenarios.title: Return and sign in
steps: Open account access from the public lobby.
Submit the registered email and password.
Confirm the authenticated user bar shows the standard user's gamertag and rating.
Reload the lobby and confirm session restoration keeps the user signed in.

expected: auth.login trace is present
users SELECT is safe and correlated
session restoration reaches the lobby
unknown_until_run: replay and RUM attachment for the browser session

scenarios.title: View and update my profile
steps: Sign in as a standard user.
Select the user identity and open the own-profile surface.
Confirm gamertag, rating, avatar, favorite suit, and tagline are readable.
Change one editable preference and confirm it survives a reload.
Return to the public lobby.

expected: profile reads and updates do not expose credentials
profile update is tied to the authenticated player identity
unknown_until_run: CRUD rollup for the users table

scenarios.title: Arrive at the public lobby
steps: Open the game without an account.
Confirm the lobby is ready and the help surface is discoverable.
Confirm public play, account access, rules, and public match navigation are visible.
Confirm the standard user can start a guest game without Docker or admin access.

expected: lobby readiness and guest entry are observable
help modal opens with one low-friction guide
unknown_until_run: RUM replay CORS and ingestion status

scenarios.title: Browse public game surfaces
steps: Open the public match list and inspect available matches.
Open the spectator surface and confirm a visitor can observe without joining.
Open the ladder and inspect rankings.
Open achievements and return to the lobby.
Open a public profile from a visible player identity, when one is available.

expected: public reads are redacted to visitor-safe projections
navigation returns to the lobby without stale screen state

scenarios.title: Join a public match
steps: Open the public match list as a visitor or signed-in player.
Choose a joinable match and confirm the player name before joining.
Confirm the waiting surface shows the correct match identity and opponent state.
Confirm the match transitions into the game without duplicating the join action.

expected: join is idempotent from the visitor perspective
the joined player's projection does not leak the opponent's hidden cards
unknown_until_run: match actor and persistence CRUD rollup

scenarios.title: Resume an active match
steps: Sign in as a player with an active match.
Return to the lobby or reload the browser.
Choose RESUME and confirm the session rejoins the existing match.
Confirm the authoritative state, turn, player seat, and pending actions are restored.

expected: rejoin maps to the original player identity
state hash after resume matches the authoritative state

scenarios.title: Browse rankings
steps: Open the public ladder from the lobby.
Confirm rankings load with safe public player projections.
Open a player profile from the ladder and return without losing context.
Confirm a signed-in player's own rating agrees with the public ranking view.

expected: ladder response is visitor-safe
profile navigation preserves the selected player identity
unknown_until_run: query timing and ratings CRUD rollup

scenarios.title: Watch a live match
steps: Open the spectator lobby without joining a match.
Select an active match and confirm the viewer enters spectator mode.
Observe state updates, turn changes, spectator count, and public event log.
Confirm hidden cards and private player actions remain redacted.

expected: spectator identity is distinct from player identity
observer projection is redacted and trace-correlated
live updates remain attached to the same match.id

scenarios.title: Rewatch a completed match
steps: Open a completed match from history or a shared replay link.
Confirm the initial state and ordered action log load.
Step forward and play the replay at multiple speeds.
Copy a step link and reopen it at the same deterministic state.
Confirm public replay state and social actions do not expose credentials or private data.

expected: replay step reconstruction is deterministic
state hash and action sequence can be mapped to the source match
share links reopen the same step
unknown_until_run: browser replay span with match.id and replay.step attributes
